column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 27 (M23027): Ateraxis tiba di reruntuhan kota; para Doll The Elmo menghadang.
# Tetap Inggris: Ateraxis, Graurizard, Jojo, Voymastina, Groza Squad, Zucchero Squad,
# Sextans, OTs-14, The Elmo, Yellow Zone, Doll.
# Catatan: satu baris di file Inggris masih berbahasa Mandarin (（坠落。）= "Jatuh.").
（坠落。）
column2: （Jatuh.）

column1: (Like a star, after blooming with the most dazzling heat, turning into a stream of light and falling to the barren earth.)
column2: (Bagai bintang yang, setelah mekar dengan panas paling menyilaukan, berubah menjadi seberkas cahaya dan jatuh ke bumi yang tandus.)

column1: (Ateraxis slowly, once again, murmured this name syllable by syllable.)
column2: (Ateraxis perlahan, sekali lagi, menggumamkan nama itu suku kata demi suku kata.)

column1: (The other party is not a brand new creature, but merely a mechanical creation. However, the mighty power she displayed surpassed all her "sisters".)
column2: (Orang itu bukan makhluk yang benar-benar baru, melainkan sekadar ciptaan mekanis. Namun kekuatan dahsyat yang dia tunjukkan melampaui semua "saudari"-nya.)

column1: Mother... you and your kind are really good at creating surprises that even I find unexpected.
column2: Ibu... kau dan kaummu benar-benar pandai menciptakan kejutan yang bahkan tak terduga olehku.

column1: (She did indeed hinder her advance, and the resulting battle outcome was that the base vehicle temporarily disappeared from her sight.)
column2: (Dia memang berhasil menghambat lajunya, dan hasil pertempuran itu membuat kendaraan markas tersebut untuk sementara lenyap dari pandangannya.)

column1: (Graurizard let out a heavy nasal sound. Voymastina's attack caused a large hole in the giant dragon's body, making its internal organs constantly fall out.)
column2: (Graurizard mengeluarkan dengusan berat. Serangan Voymastina melubangi tubuh naga raksasa itu besar-besar, membuat organ dalamnya terus berjatuhan.)

column1: (Like the penetrating wound that shot Graurizard down from high altitude before, this wound will eventually heal, but in the next dozen hours or so, it will greatly affect Graurizard's strength.)
column2: (Seperti luka tembus yang dulu menjatuhkan Graurizard dari ketinggian, luka ini pada akhirnya akan sembuh, tapi dalam belasan jam ke depan, itu akan sangat memengaruhi kekuatannya.)

column1: Don't say that, Jojo.
column2: Jangan bilang begitu, Jojo.

column1: The other party risked everything to fight you, she is a Doll worth liking.
column2: Orang itu mempertaruhkan segalanya untuk melawanmu, dia Doll yang pantas disukai.

column1: (She is not impatient.)
column2: (Dia tidak tidak sabar.)

column1: (Or rather, even if she wanted to experience the emotion called "impatience", it seemed difficult to do so.)
column2: (Atau lebih tepatnya, sekalipun dia ingin merasakan emosi bernama "tidak sabar", itu tampaknya sulit dilakukan.)

column1: (Even she herself found it hard to imagine what exactly would have to happen to make her feel that way.)
column2: (Dia sendiri pun sulit membayangkan apa persisnya yang harus terjadi agar dia merasakannya.)

column1: As long as 'that' is still around, we won't lose the Commander or The Elmo.
column2: Selama 'itu' masih ada, kita tidak akan kehilangan Komandan maupun Elmo.

column1: I was just thinking... what is the point of them doing this?
column2: Aku cuma berpikir... apa gunanya mereka melakukan ini?

column1: Voymastina doesn't seem foolish enough to actually think she can defeat us.
column2: Voymastina sepertinya tidak sebodoh itu sampai benar-benar mengira bisa mengalahkan kita.

column1: Were her actions merely to delay our advance and let the Commander escape?
column2: Apakah tindakannya semata untuk memperlambat laju kita dan membiarkan Komandan lolos?

column1: However, the Commander I know doesn't seem like someone who would allow such a scheme.
column2: Tapi Komandan yang kukenal sepertinya bukan orang yang akan mengizinkan siasat semacam itu.

column1: Then it must be understood this way—she hopes to change something through this desperate struggle.
column2: Maka harus dipahami begini—dia berharap mengubah sesuatu lewat perjuangan nekat itu.

column1: (Graurizard let out a low roar.)
column2: (Graurizard mengeluarkan raungan rendah.)

column1: ...No, Jojo.
column2: ...Tidak, Jojo.

column1: I don't believe that the one chosen by that goddess would be a cowardly wretch afraid of death.
column2: Aku tidak percaya orang yang dipilih dewi itu adalah pengecut hina yang takut mati.

column1: So—that's why I'm curious.
column2: Karena itulah—aku jadi penasaran.

column1: What else have they prepared for us?
column2: Apa lagi yang sudah mereka siapkan untuk kita?

column1: (She likes Voymastina.)
column2: (Dia menyukai Voymastina.)

column1: (She likes existences with strong wills, full of... vibrant vitality.)
column2: (Dia menyukai keberadaan yang berkehendak kuat, penuh... daya hidup yang berdenyut.)

column1: (But, now, at this moment.)
column2: (Tapi, sekarang, saat ini.)

column1: (...The most powerful Doll is nothing more than a trivial 'footnote' on her path forward.)
column2: (...Doll terkuat pun tak lebih dari 'catatan kaki' sepele di jalannya ke depan.)

column1: (She looked down at the golden sea of sand.)
column2: (Dia menatap turun ke lautan pasir keemasan.)

column1: (On the grayish horizon, what gradually emerged was a landscape connected into a line.)
column2: (Di cakrawala yang kelabu, yang perlahan muncul adalah bentang lahan yang menyambung jadi satu garis.)

column1: (That is the edge of the Yellow Zone, the remains of a once prosperous and flourishing city.)
column2: (Itulah tepi Yellow Zone, sisa-sisa kota yang dulu makmur dan berkembang.)

column1: (Ateraxis doesn't like this kind of scenery, just as she has always found it hard to like the land her mother is attached to.)
column2: (Ateraxis tidak menyukai pemandangan semacam itu, sama seperti dia selalu sulit menyukai tanah yang dilekati ibunya.)

column1: (Gray, unbearable, leaving nothing behind except memories of the past.)
column2: (Kelabu, tak tertahankan, tidak menyisakan apa pun selain kenangan masa lalu.)

column1: Roar...
column2: Raung...

column1: Don't destroy them, Jojo.
column2: Jangan hancurkan mereka, Jojo.

column1: These are all they have left.
column2: Cuma ini yang tersisa bagi mereka.

column1: When these traces disappear, they will have never existed at all.
column2: Kalau jejak-jejak ini lenyap, mereka jadi seolah tak pernah ada sama sekali.

column1: (Those uneven, well-proportioned buildings are both the glory of the past and the most excellent cover for The Elmo at this very moment.)
column2: (Bangunan-bangunan yang tak rata namun berimbang itu sekaligus kemuliaan masa lalu dan perlindungan terbaik bagi Elmo saat ini.)

column1: (To Graurizard, they are just toys waiting to be knocked down.)
column2: (Bagi Graurizard, semua itu cuma mainan yang menunggu dirobohkan.)

column1: (But to Ateraxis, this too is a form of life.)
column2: (Tapi bagi Ateraxis, itu pun sebentuk kehidupan.)

column1: (She still has plenty of time.)
column2: (Waktunya masih banyak.)

column1: The more you wait, the more you look forward to it...
column2: Makin lama menunggu, makin besar rasa penasarannya...

column1: Moreover, this is the battlefield the Commander personally chose.
column2: Lagi pula, ini medan tempur yang dipilih sendiri oleh Komandan.

column1: I'm very curious, what kind of prelude he... they will prepare for me.
column2: Aku sangat penasaran, pembuka seperti apa yang akan dia... mereka siapkan untukku.

column1: (The giant dragon dove down from an altitude of a thousand meters, then spread its wings and landed on the edge of the town ruins in an elegant gliding posture.)
column2: (Naga raksasa itu menukik dari ketinggian seribu meter, lalu membentangkan sayapnya dan mendarat di tepi reruntuhan kota dengan luncuran yang anggun.)

column1: (The young girl lightly jumped off the dragon's back and stepped forward lightly along the black stone brick road mostly buried by sand.)
column2: (Gadis muda itu melompat ringan dari punggung naga dan melangkah ringan menyusuri jalan bata batu hitam yang sebagian besar terkubur pasir.)

column1: (She could smell that scent—)
column2: (Dia bisa mencium aroma itu—)

column1: (That's right, The Elmo is somewhere deep inside, waiting for her.)
column2: (Benar, Elmo ada di suatu tempat jauh di dalam sana, menunggunya.)

column1: (—She felt those slightly rippling emotions in her heart.)
column2: (—Dia merasakan emosi yang sedikit beriak di hatinya.)

column1: (An emotion called 'joy'.)
column2: (Emosi yang bernama 'sukacita'.)

column1: —Groza Squad, in position.
column2: —Groza Squad, di posisi.

column1: —Zucchero Squad, in position.
column2: —Zucchero Squad, di posisi.

column1: —Sextans, in position.
column2: —Sextans, di posisi.

column1: OTs-14... in position.
column2: OTs-14... di posisi.

column1: (She looked gently at those Dolls belonging to The Elmo, one after another, pouring out from all corners one by one, raising their guns and pointing them at her.)
column2: (Dia menatap lembut para Doll milik Elmo itu, satu demi satu bermunculan dari segala sudut, mengangkat senjata dan mengarahkannya padanya.)

column1: (Among them, also included her "sisters".)
column2: (Di antara mereka, termasuk pula "saudari-saudari"-nya.)

column1: (At this moment, standing in front of her, what are they thinking?)
column2: (Saat ini, berdiri di hadapannya, apa yang mereka pikirkan?)

column1: (She raised her head.)
column2: (Dia mendongak.)

column1: It wasn't a probe.
column2: Ini bukan penjajakan.

column1: Nor is it an ambush.
column2: Bukan pula penyergapan.

column1: Nor are you naive enough to think that mere weak numbers are enough to confront me.
column2: Kalian juga tidak sepolos itu sampai mengira jumlah yang sedikit ini cukup untuk menghadapiku.

column1: What supports you standing in front of me is merely the will to protect "that person".
column2: Yang menopang kalian berdiri di hadapanku semata kehendak untuk melindungi "orang itu".

column1: It is the fighting spirit of knowing it's impossible, yet still doing it.
column2: Itulah semangat tempur yang tahu ini mustahil, tapi tetap dijalani.

column1: Is it the struggle of being unwilling to accept reality?
column2: Apakah ini perlawanan karena tak rela menerima kenyataan?

column1: Or...
column2: Atau...

column1: ...Have I still failed to gain your understanding, making you think you still have a chance of winning?
column2: ...Apakah aku masih gagal membuat kalian mengerti, sehingga kalian mengira masih punya peluang menang?

column1: (No one gave her a response.)
column2: (Tak seorang pun memberinya jawaban.)

column1: (Neither the Dolls, nor the human standing fearlessly in the command room of The Elmo.)
column2: (Baik para Doll, maupun manusia yang berdiri tanpa gentar di ruang komando Elmo.)

column1: Then... please.
column2: Kalau begitu... silakan.

column1: —Fire!
column2: —Tembak!

column1: (Bang—!!)
(BOOM—!!)
column2: (BUUM—!!)

column1: (Under the pattering artillery fire that poured down like a canopy of shooting stars.)
column2: (Di bawah tembakan artileri yang berderai turun bagai kanopi bintang jatuh.)

column1: (Ateraxis lifted her long dress to pay tribute to the warriors.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengangkat ujung gaun panjangnya untuk memberi hormat pada para pejuang.)
